source: Chapter 688: Preparations
target: Capitulum 688: Praeparationes

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: As Lumian heard his heartbeat, a palm reached out from the open door of the black ancient tomb.
target: Cum Lumian pulsationem cordis audivit, palma ex aperta porta sepulcri antiquati nigri se protendit.

source: The palm showed no signs of decay or yellow bandages.
target: Palma nulla signa putredinis nec fascias flavas ostendebat.

source: Its surface was covered in gold, shimmering with a mystical hue under the dim crimson moonlight.
target: Superficies eius auro suffusa erat, micans colore mystico sub tenui luce lunae rubrae.

source: Upon seeing the golden palm, Lumian felt an invisible force compress his soul, instantly severing its connection to his body.
target: Videns palmam auream, Lumian vim invisibilis sensit, quae animam suam comprimebat, statim eius nexum cum corpore interrumpens.

source: Immediately after, he realized his body had transformed into a cold, solid wall, preventing his spirit from spreading or being controlled by his consciousness.
target: Statim postea animadvertit corpus eius in murum durum et frigidum conversum esse, impediens spiritui eius se diffundere aut a conscientia regi.

source: At that moment, Lumian’s soul felt trapped in a cage, unable to escape.
target: Illo momento, anima Lumiani in cavea inclusa se sensit, nec evadere posse.

source: He could only see limited scenes through his eyes and hear relatively loud voices with his ears.
target: Tantum scaenas restrictas per oculos videre et voces satis sonoras per auribus audire poterat.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Everyone present turned into statues, frozen in place.
target: Omnes presenti in statuas conversi sunt, in loco immobiliter.

source: Faced with this situation, Lumian suddenly recalled a saying: The body is a cage for the heart, and the world is a cage for the body.
target: Hac re circumstante, Lumian subito memoriae adduxit proverbium: "Corpus est cavea cordis, et mundus est cavea corporis."

source: In the stillness, the only person still moving was “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: In silentio, sola persona adhuc movens erat "Hisoka" Twanaku.

source: The golden mask on his face emitted a hazy glow as he swiftly approached the black ancient tomb and the golden palm extending from it.
target: Larva aurea in facie eius fulgor nebulosus emanabat, dum celeriter ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum et ab eo protrahentem palmam auream accedebat.

source: Although Lumian couldn’t move or use his abilities, his soul was merely “imprisoned”—it didn’t affect his thoughts.
target: Etsi Lumian movendi vel facultates suas adhibendi non poterat, anima eius modo "inclusa" erat—nec cogitationes eius afficiebat.

source: Seeing that “Hisoka” Twanaku was almost unaffected by the golden palm, Lumian quickly deduced several things.
target: Videns "Hisoka" Twanaku paene impassibilem palmam auream, Lumian celeriter plura concludit.

source: There’s a high likelihood the gold Hisoka seized from Devise—the gold mine city—was used on the cold corpse in the black ancient tomb.
target: Altissima verisimilitudo est aurum, quod Hisoka ab urbe Devise, fodina aurea, rapuit, in cadavero frigido sepulcri antiquati nigri adhibitum esse.

source: The item he obtained from the Nois family’s Demon is likely the golden mask he now wears.
target: Res, quam a daemone familiae Nois obtinuit, probabiliter est larva aurea quam nunc gerit.

source: The former was an attempt to revive the cold corpse.
target: Primum conatum erat cadaver frigidi reviviscere.

source: Its equivalent to Franca’s mention of creating a complete body.
target: Eius aequipollentia est ad dictatum Francae de corpore completo creando.

source: The latter ensures Hisoka can approach the target unaffected after the cold corpse’s "resurrection" and achieve a certain goal.
target: Ultimum efficit ut Hisoka, post resurrectionem cadaveris frigidi, scopum immotus attingat et certum finem assequatur.

source: Did Hisoka once plan to use this to control the cold corpse and attain demigod-level strength?
target: Numquid Hisoka olim hoc consilium habuit ut cadaver frigidi regeret ac virtutem semi-dei adipiscatur?

source: When I killed him in the real world, did the him in the dream attempt to "resurrect" through this?
target: Cum eum in mundo reali interfecissem, numquid ille in somnio per hoc "resurrectionem" conari studuit?

source: Yes, Hisoka’s Wraith power comes from the same source as the cold corpse.
target: Ita, potentia umbrae Hisoka eadem fonte emanat ac cadaver frigidi.

source: Perhaps there’s a way to make the corpse believe he’s its original spirit and accept his lead…
target: Forsitan via sit ut cadaver credat se esse spiritum originalem suum et ducatum eius accipiat…

source: Based on the information I’ve gathered and what just transpired, humans who have received the boon of the black ancient tomb and the cold corpse can open the tomb without waking the corpse.
target: Ex informationibus congregatis et rebus nuper transactis, homines qui beneficium sepulcri antiquati nigri et cadaveris frigidi receperunt, sepulcrum aperire possunt sine cadaver excitando.

source: To awaken it, an intruder must be bestowed with immortality by an invisible figure, ascend to godhood, and enter the ancient tomb.
target: Ut illud excitetur, invasori immortalis a figura invisibili donandus est, deitatis gradus ascendere atque in sepulcrum antiquatum intrare.

source: And intruders will only be attacked by invisible figures without the Dream Festival’s bestowed guides…
target: Et invasores tantum figuris invisibilibus oppugnabuntur, sine ducum Festi Somniorum donatorum…

source: It’s best for an intruder to remain lucid?
target: Optime est ut invasor lucidus maneat?

source: How did Hisoka know outsiders would participate in the Dream Festival this year and arrive at the black ancient tomb?
target: Quomodo Hisoka scivit extraneos in Festo Somniorum hoc anno participaturos esse atque ad sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum pervenire?

source: He didn’t have such a plan to begin with?
target: Nonne talis consilium initio habuit?

source: That’s because he didn’t know he was going to die.
target: Quia nesciebat se moriturum esse.

source: If he can’t complete his plan during this year’s Dream Festival, the dream projection will completely dissipate in the next few months, causing him to lose his last hope of revival…
target: Si consilium suum in Festo Somniorum huius anni perficere non poterit, proiectio somniorum omnino in proximis mensibus evanescet, eum ultima spes reviviscendi amittens…

source: The involvement of outsiders was a pleasant surprise for him?
target: Num externorum interventus ei gratus erat?

source: No, it's too much of a coincidence.
target: Minime, nimis fortuito est.

source: Reaza’s rushing over can be explained by his discovery of me investigating the Dream Festival and his worry that he wouldn’t have a chance to obtain what he wants after this year.
target: Cursor Reazae explicari potest ex eius deprehensione mei, qui Festo Somniorum investigabam, et sollicitudine ne post hunc annum id, quod desiderat, adipisci posset.

source: But why did Iveljsta coincidentally come to this primitive forest to investigate something?
target: Sed cur Iveljsta casu ad hanc silvam primitivam venit, ut aliquid indagheret?

source: Why did two Beyonders who can remain lucid in the special dream arrive just before the Dream Festival began?
target: Cur duo Beyonders, qui in somnio speciali lucidi manere possunt, paene ante initium Festi Somniorum advenerunt?

source: Moreover, why did the Rose School of Thought send someone to Matani in the last few months of the year to gather detailed day-to-day information?
target: Praeterea, cur Schola Rosae Sententiarum aliquem ad Matani misit in paucis mensibus ultimi anni ut accuratas informationes cotidianas colligeret?

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku originally planned to complete his plan during this year’s Dream Festival.
target: "Hisoka" Twanaku primum consilium suum in Festo Somniorum huius anni perficere destinavit.

source: He deliberately leaked some information and clues to attract different factions of interest.
target: Diligenter quaedam informationes et indicia effudit, ut diversas factiones studii alliceret.

source: The information these factions received wasn’t detailed enough.
target: Notitia quam hae factiones acceperunt non satis accurata erat.

source: They had no choice but to dispatch personnel in advance to conduct the corresponding investigations or bribe members of Matani’s patrol teams…
target: Nullo alio modo nisi ut ante miscerentur operarii ad investigationes pertinentes peragendas, vel ut membra turmae Matani subornarent.

source: This may very well be the truth, a truth that doesn’t rely on coincidence.
target: Hoc valde verisimile veritas est, veritas quae non innititur casu.

source: The only thing Hisoka didn’t anticipate was his demise before the Dream Festival began.
target: Sola re quam Hisoka non praevidebat, mors eius ante initium Festi Somniorum evenit.

source: Now, the Dream Festival is his last and only hope for resurrection.
target: Nunc, Festum Somniorum ultima et sola spes eius ad resurrectionem est.

source: If he fails to achieve his plan, he will die completely after today!
target: Si consilium suum perficere non poterit, post hunc diem penitus morietur!

source: No wonder he’s so secretive about Tizamo despite being honest about everything else in the dream…
target: Non mirum est quod de Tizamo tam arcanus se ostendat, cum de ceteris in somnio vereus esset.

source: Hisoka is truly a cunning Devil skilled at manipulating people’s hearts.
target: Hisoka vere callidus Diabolus est, peritia in corda hominum regenda praedita.

source: If he hadn’t been bent on killing me and his identity had given him a good opportunity to choose to stay in Port Pylos, he wouldn’t have been easy to lull.
target: Si non constanter intentus ad me interficendum fuisset atque eius identitas ei bonam occasionem praebuisset ut in Port Pylos maneret, facile non mollitus fuisset.

source: Yes, if I had played by the book and lacked the goodwill of a high-ranking entity, I might have died at his hands.
target: Ita, si praeceptis obtemperavissem et bonam voluntatem entitatis praestantis non haberem, a manu eius moriturus fuissem.

source: The Demon of the Nois family also has designs on the cold corpse in the black tomb and wants to use the Dream Festival.
target: Daemon familiae Nois quoque consilia habet in cadavero frigido sepulcri nigri et Festum Somniorum adhibere vult.

source: Therefore, when Hisoka mentioned the Dream Festival in his dream, he was immediately attacked by the shadow…
target: Ergo, cum Hisoka in somnio suo Festum Somniorum memoravit, statim ab umbra oppressus est…

source: Among those present, who is the Demon’s minion?
target: Inter eos presentes, quis est famulus daemonis?

source: Or could it be that the Demon from the Nois family hasn’t arrived yet and wants to wait until the end, when the situation is clear, before taking action and completing the harvest?
target: An forte Daemon familiae Nois nondum advenerit et velit exspectare usque ad finem, cum res clarescant, antequam agatur et messis perficatur?

source: If it’s just a dream projection, without the main body’s cooperation, there should be a huge loophole in Hisoka’s plan.
target: Si solum proiectio somnii sit, sine cooperatione corporis principali, ingens hiatus in consilio Hisoka esse debet.

source: Where is the loophole?
target: Ubi est hiatus?

source: Trapped in his body, Lumian couldn’t stop Hisoka.
target: Corpori suo inclusus, Lumian Hisokam sistere non potuit.

source: He watched helplessly as Hisoka ran to the open door of the black ancient tomb.
target: Inermis spectavit, dum Hisoka ad apertam portam sepulcri antiquati nigri cucurrit.

source: Wait…
target: Exspecta…

source: Since the black ancient tomb reminds me of the Samaritan Women’s Spring, I can try that method…
target: Cum sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum me admonet Fons Mulierum Samaritanarum, illam viam experiri possum…

source: Lumian acted without hesitation, focusing his attention on his Spirit Body’s right hand.
target: Lumian sine mora egit, animum suum in manum dexteram Corporis Spiritus intendens.

source: Alista Tudor’s remnant aura didn’t just permeate his body!
target: Aura residua Alista Tudor non solum corpus eius pervasit!

source: And the Blood Emperor was closely linked to the Samaritan Women’s Spring!
target: Et Imperator Sanguinis arcte cum Fonte Mulierum Samaritanarum coniunctus erat!

source: Wearing a golden mask, Hisoka’s body began to etherealize uncontrollably.
target: Larvam auream gerens, corpus Hisokae irrationabiliter in aetherem mutari coepit.

source: Just as he was about to grasp the hand of the corpse protruding from the black ancient tomb, he suddenly sensed an extremely terrifying, frenzied, and violent aura appearing behind him.
target: Iam cum manum cadaveris, quae ex sepulcro antiquato nigro protulisset, arripere pararet, subito sensit auram extremam, terribilem, et furibundam post se apparire.

source: It soared into the sky explosively, sweeping through the surroundings.
target: Explosione in caelum volavit, circumiecta vastans.

source: The crimson moon’s glow dimmed, and “Hisoka” Twanaku’s body instinctively stiffened, trembling violently.
target: Lux lunaris carminis rubri attenuata est, et corpus "Hisoka" Twanaku instinctu riguit, violentissime tremens.

source: Splash!
target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

source: An illusory sound of water echoed from the black ancient tomb, and the golden palm seemed to be dragged back into the tomb by some unknown force.
target: Sonus aquae illusorius ex sepulcro antiquato nigro resonavit, et palma aurea videbatur aliqua ignota vi in sepulcrum revocari.

source: The feeling of their souls being imprisoned within their bodies dissipated.
target: Sensatio animarum eorum intra corpora inclusarum evanuit.

source: Lumian hurriedly halted the dissipation of the Blood Emperor’s aura.
target: Lumian festinanter dismissionem aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis cohibuit.

source: Although Amandina, Camus, Devajo, and the others instinctively felt fear, the confinement of their spirits and fixed line of sight prevented them from discovering the source of the aura that conquered everything.
target: Quamvis Amandina, Camus, Devajo, et ceteri instinctu timorem sentirent, confinatio spirituum eorum et linea visus fixa eos impediunt ut fontem aurae, quae omnia superabat, detegerent.

source: Ignoring the search for the origin of the terrifying aura, the fierce-eyed Iveljsta followed his instinctive desire and retrieved an item from his hidden pocket.
target: Originem aurae terribilis neglexit, et Iveljsta, oculis ferocibus, instinctum sequens rem ex sinu occulto extraxit.

source: It was a palm-sized rag doll, dressed in a black Gothic dress entwined with eerie vines.
target: Erat pupula magnitudinis palmae, in veste Gothica nigra induta, vites insolitas circumtexta.

source: It had long golden hair and blood-red eyes.
target: Capillum longum aureum habebat et oculos sanguine rubros.

source: The doll was sinister.
target: Pupula sinistra erat.

source: Just the sight of it made Lumian’s flesh crawl beneath his skin.
target: Ipsius eius aspectus carnem Lumiani sub cute agitantem faciebat.

source: Thud! Thud! Thud!
target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

source: The heartbeat in the black ancient tomb intensified, becoming resounding.
target: Pulsus cordis in sepulcro antiquato nigro intensificatus est, sonorus factus.

source: Beside the tomb door, “Hisoka” Twanaku felt a chill run down his spine, as if targeted by an evil being.
target: Apud ianuam sepulcri, "Hisoka" Twanaku frigidum per dorsum currere sensit, quasi a mala entitate destinatus.

source: Instinctively, he recalled something.
target: Instincte, aliquid meminit.

source: Years ago, gravekeepers had found a half-withered evil heart near the black ancient tomb.
target: Ante annos, custodes sepulchri cor maleficum semi-exsiccatum prope sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum invenerunt.

source: The gravekeepers believed that the ancient corpse in the tomb had been lost due to some mutation.
target: Custodes sepulchri crediderunt antiquatum cadaver in sepulcro ob aliquam mutationem amissum esse.

source: After all, the characteristics of its power were the same, and the levels seemed similar.
target: Nam proprietates potentiae eius eadem erant, et gradus similes videbantur.

source: Therefore, they placed the heart back into the tomb.
target: Ergo cor iterum in sepulcrum reponerunt.

source: Just a moment ago, the long-dead heart had begun to beat, but now it beat stronger and faster!
target: Modo abhinc, cor diu mortuum pulsare coepit, sed nunc fortius atque celerius pulsabat!

source: Not far from Iveljsta, Reaza also made a move.
target: Non longe ab Iveljsta, Reaza quoque motum fecit.

source: He produced a mask.
target: Larvam produxit.

source: The mask, also made of gold, bore a striking resemblance to the one worn by Hisoka.
target: Larva, etiam ex auro facta, eminenti similitudine induta erat cum ea, quam Hisoka gerebat.

source: Varying shades of white and black paint adorned the eyes and face!
target: Toni varii albi et nigri oculos et faciem ornabant!

source: The difference between the two golden masks was that the one in Reaza’s hand was darker, as if touched by death.
target: Differentia inter duas larvas aureas erat quod illa in manu Reaza obscurius videbatur, quasi morte tincta.

source: Then, Reaza produced a human skull carved from crystal.
target: Deinde, Reaza calvariam hominis ex crystallo sculptam produxit.

source: He placed the dark golden mask on the crystal skull’s face.
target: Posuit larvam auream obscuram super faciem calvariae crystallinae.

source: A frigid wind gusted, engulfing the crystal skull in a massive vortex.
target: Frigidus ventus impetu sufflavit, calvariam crystallinam in ingenti vortice devorans.

source: The crystal skull, adorned with the golden mask, levitated, as if it had grown an invisible body made of wind.
target: Calvaria crystallina, larva aurea ornata, levitabat, quasi corpus invisibile ex vento factum haberet.

source: An intense coldness spread in all directions, condensing a layer of frost on the ground.
target: Intensa frigiditas in omnibus partibus diffusa est, stratum pruinae in solo condensans.

source: The man named Devajo reached behind his head and grasped something in his hair.
target: Vir nomine Devajo post caput suum pervenit et aliquid in capillis apprehendit.

source: With a sudden tug, he ripped off his skin, along with his dark gray suit.
target: Subito trahente, cutem suam una cum vestimento griseo obscuro evellit.

source: Devajo took on a different appearance.
target: Devajo aliam speciem induit.

source: He had black hair, brown eyes, a cold expression, and high cheekbones.
target: Capillos nigros habebat, oculos fuscos, vultum frigidum, atque genae altas.

source: He was in his thirties or forties, dressed in a white shirt and black pants.
target: Inter tricesimum et quadragesimum aetas, indutus veste alba tunica et bracas negras, erat.

source: He flipped the human skin in his hand, revealing dense, dizzying blood embroidery beneath.
target: Cutem humanam in manu sua vertit, subdeponens densam et vertiginosam sanguinis ornamentationem.

source: Devajo opened his mouth and spat out mouthfuls of blood, emitting a strong sulfuric smell.
target: Devajo os aperuit et guttas sanguinis exspulit, fortem odorem sulfureum emittens.

source: The blood protruded from the human skin, forming a green-eyed man in a dark gray suit.
target: Sanguis ex cute humana prolapsus, virum oculis viridibus in veste grisea obscura formavit.

source: With a playful smile, the “man” approached the black ancient tomb.
target: Cum risu ludenti, "vir" ad sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum accedebat.

source: Lumian quickly scanned the area, his eyelids twitching three times.
target: Lumian celeriter aream perlustrare coepit, palpebris oculorum ter concutiens.

source: He couldn’t help but criticize, "Do you all possess godhood-level powers that you can utilize? Although they all seem to be one-time use… Are you bullying me for not having any?"
target: Non potuit quin reprehenderetur: "Habitisne omnes potentias deitatis adhibendas? Quamquam omnes videntur solum ad usum unum destinatae… me vexatis quod nullas habeo?"

source: Despite Lumian’s criticism, he quickly recited an honorific name in ancient Hermes.
target: Quamquam Lumiani reprehensione, celeriter nomen honorificum in antiquo Hermete recitavit.

source: It was Madam Magician’s honorific name.
target: Erat nomen honorificum Dominae Magicae.

source: However, it failed to penetrate this special and hidden dream.
target: Attamen, illud penetrare somnium hoc speciale et occultum non potuit.

source: Lumian wasn’t dejected.
target: Lumian non deiectus est.

source: His goal wasn’t the black ancient tomb, nor was it the cold corpse or its beating heart.
target: Propositum eius non erat sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum, neque cadaver frigidus aut cor eius pulsans.

source: Now that he knew the whereabouts of Hisoka’s gold, there was only one thing he wanted to do.
target: Iam quod locum auri Hisokae cognovisset, unum tantum agere volebat.

source: Eliminate Hisoka’s dream projection, take away the golden mask, and let him perish completely!
target: Elimina proiectionem somnii Hisokae, aufer larvam auream, et sinito eum penitus perire!
